2609.25773.title: Video-HopChain: Multi-Hop Questions and Confidence-Gated Exploration for Video Reasoning Models
2609.25773.paper_summary: HopChain has shown on still images that multi-hop data synthesis improves vision-language reasoning, because long chain-of-thought reasoning exposes errors that compound across steps, while most data used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rarely demands a chain of visual evidence, so these weaknesses are likely to stay unexposed. We observe the same problem in video, where this framework has not yet been explored. We therefore build Video-HopChain, a dataset of 22,550 multi-hop video questions over 13,378 videos, together with a held-out benchmark of 1,000 questions. Each question chains three to six yes/no questions about moments in one video, and each yields one of two integers depending on its answer. The final answer is the sum of these integers, so an exact match on that sum gives the verifiable reward that RLVR needs. We first train Qwen3-VL-8B with GRPO on a standard video dataset, and a second stage on Video-HopChain then raises the mean over eight video understanding and reasoning benchmarks from 55.4 to 57.9 and improves every one of them. Training on such a dataset, however, exposes a known limitation of GRPO: its learning signal comes from the reward variance within a group, so hard questions whose rollouts are all incorrect and easy questions whose rollouts are all correct both leave the group with no gradient. To recover these groups at the same compute budget, we introduce Confidence-Gated Exploration (CGE). With 8 rollouts per question, CGE samples the first 4 as usual. If these 4 are either all correct or all incorrect, it samples the last 4 with the policy's most confident token masked inside the reasoning span, and removes the masked positions from the loss while all 8 rollouts enter the advantage. With CGE, the mean rises further to 59.3. We release the dataset, the checkpoint, and the data generation and training code.
2609.25773.paper_summary_zh: HopChain 在靜態影像上顯示，多跳數據合成改善了視覺-語言推理，因為長鏈思考推理暴露了在步驟中累積的錯誤，而大多數用於可驗證獎勵的強化學習 (RLVR) 數據很少要求可視證據的鏈，因此這些弱點可能會保持未被揭露。 我們在視頻中觀察到相同的問題，這個框架尚未被探索。 因此，我們建立了 Video-HopChain，一個包含 22,550 個多跳視頻問題的數據集，涵蓋 13,378 個視頻，並附有 1,000 個問題的保留基準。 每個問題鏈接三到六個有關單個視頻中時刻的是/否問題，並根據其答案產生兩個整數之一。 最終答案是這些整數的總和，因此在該總和上的精確匹配提供了 RLVR 所需的可驗證獎勵。 我們首先在標準視頻數據集上使用 GRPO 訓練 Qwen3-VL-8B，然後在 Video-HopChain 上進行第二階段訓練，將八個視頻理解和推理基準的平均值從 55.4 提升到 57.9，並改善了每一個基準。 然而，在這樣的數據集上訓練暴露了 GRPO 的一個已知限制：其學習信號來自於一組內的獎勵方差，因此所有回合都是錯誤的難題和所有回合都是正確的簡單問題都使該組沒有梯度。 為了在相同的計算預算下恢復這些組，我們引入了信心門控探索 (CGE)。 每個問題進行 8 次回合，CGE 像往常一樣取前 4 次。如果這 4 次都是正確的或都是錯誤的，它將用政策中最有信心的標記在推理範圍內來抽樣最後 4 次，並在所有 8 次回合進入優勢的同時從損失中移除被遮罩的位置。 使用 CGE，平均值進一步上升到 59.3。 我們發布了數據集、檢查點以及數據生成和訓練代碼。
